audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags it outright: Gragas wins 46.92% of 292 games but the chart handed him 5 of 7 stages against 1. phases[0] also said 'Akshan' while its own why-text claimed you win level 1 outright, and whys[0] says neither side owns it.
audit.why: A losing win rate cannot sit under a chart that gives the owner a five-stage sweep. The two stages the prose genuinely gives away are level 6 (Comeuppance plus roam tempo) and the two-item mark, where the late text already says he out-spaces you and you must not duel him in a side lane.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill / Skill / Gragas / Gragas / Akshan / Gragas / Akshan — three to two with two even, matching both the sub-50% win rate and the existing prose.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4] carried the generic 'Explosive Cask finishes kills — you choose the fight' line for a stage the chart marks as Akshan's, and phases[6] claimed your side-lane pattern is at full power when the late-game text says the opposite.
audit.why: Comeuppance is 100/85/70s and fires stored bullets scaling on missing health, which is what turns your survived all-in into a death. His two-item spike is a lethality skirmisher that kites a telegraphed Body Slam and resets off Scoundrel revives.
audit.corrected: phases[4] names Comeuppance and its 100s cooldown as his window; phases[6] states he out-spaces you late and points you at closing on the mid-game lead.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeGood, tradeBad and dontsFull[1].d were template filler with no ability named. dontsFull[1] was titled 'Throw R the wrong direction' but its body was about burning an ultimate for tiny value — it never explained which direction is wrong.
audit.why: Heroic Swing is 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s and is his only escape from your stun, so it is the cooldown the whole lane keys off. Body Slam is 14s at rank 1, not 13 as the template said. Explosive Cask knocks enemies back away from the blast centre, so the aim point has to be past him, not on him — the mirror audit recorded the same displacement direction.
audit.corrected: tradeGood and tradeBad now key to Heroic Swing (18s) and Body Slam's real 14s; dontsFull[1].d states the knockback direction so 'the wrong direction' finally means something.

audit.why: Nothing in the brief indicates a recent Akshan or Gragas change on 26.15, and no patch-note source was available to verify one. Left untouched rather than asserted.

edits.before: Q-poke from range wins level 1 outright. Identify how Akshan contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Neither owns level 1 — his Avengerang chips, Happy Hour heals it back. Don't throw a naked Barrel Roll he can just step.

edits.before: W damage reduction + sustain flips his return trade. Only take the trade when Akshan's Heroic Swing is down.
edits.after: Drunken Rage's flat 5s damage reduction flips his poke, but he can still grapple out on Heroic Swing (18s).

edits.before: Explosive Cask both finishes kills and deletes engages — you choose the fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Akshan's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: His window, not yours: Comeuppance (100s) fires missing-health bullets that finish an all-in you survived, and his roam tempo spikes at 6.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Akshan carry threat 7.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: He out-spaces your telegraphed combo in a side lane and resets off revives. Close on your mid-game lead instead of dueling him.

edits.before: Q-poke Akshan on cooldown from fog angles, W as he answers, and E-slam only when his key tool is down.
edits.after: Barrel Roll from fog angles, Drunken Rage as he answers, Body Slam only once Heroic Swing (18s) is spent.

edits.before: Body-slamming INTO his answer — a whiffed E is 13 seconds of being a barrel with no plan.
edits.after: Body Slam at a full-cooldown Akshan — a whiffed E is 14 seconds with no engage left.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Explosive Cask knocks back from the blast centre — aim past him.

edits.before: Your durable engage and Explosive Cask peel still beat his squishy lethality frame in a forced fight if you commit before his revive picks snowball.
edits.after: He out-spaces your telegraphed Body Slam late and resets skirmishes off Scoundrel revives — your only route is a forced fight with Explosive Cask peel.

notes: Chart flips proposed as one atomic group across both layers, resolving the packet's own defect ('Gragas wins only 46.92% but the chart gives Gragas 5/7 stages'). New chart: Skill/Skill/Gragas/Gragas/Akshan/Gragas/Akshan. Kept the mid-game stages with Gragas because the existing prose supports them concretely; the two stages given back are the ones the page's own late text already concedes. Heroic Swing per the kit is 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s, so 18s is rank 1 — worth knowing that it drops to 12s by rank 5 and the 'bait the grapple' plan gets much weaker late.
